events.what: Zhi-Wei Sun claims a proof that Catalan's constant is irrational
events.credibility_reason: Wachs (arXiv:2609.22339) shows the Theorem 9.1 quantity the proof needs to be negative is numerically about +1.5 to +1.9 B², plus a missing prime-2 term; an independent partial Lean slice measures ~+1.86. No response or v2 from Sun.
events.ai_basis: The author's many rounds of conversations with AI provide the basis of this paper. ... The needed numerical data in the proof were produced by AI.

events.what: Jonathan Reed Zenodo writeup claiming a Lean-checked proof that gamma is irrational
events.credibility_reason: Landmark problem, self-published on Zenodo, no expert uptake in ~6 months, later 2025-2026 work still treats gamma's irrationality as open; rests only on a formal check (F10).

events.what: Bai lowers the irrationality-measure bound of pi to 7.1018...
Yu's no-go result on Apery-type certificates for irrationality of e+pi

judgement.doubts: Sun's claim would have been a case (one of fourteen constants), never whole, so 'claimed' was wrong even before Wachs (F1/F2). Pi itself is not in the bullet's list, so Bai's bound is out of scope. If Sun posts a repaired v2 that survives scrutiny, this becomes partial with ai_role assisted.

corrections.why: F6/F1/F2: the record's own dispute says Wachs found the key Theorem 9.1 quantity is numerically positive (+1.5 to +1.9 B²) where the proof needs it negative, corroborated by the Lean slice, and no answer from Sun, so the claim is knocked down; in any case one constant of fourteen is a case, not whole. The Reed gamma claim is not credible, and the pi bound is out of scope, so nothing survives.
F6/F8: the AI role belonged to Sun's knocked-down preprint, which cannot set the status; with no event surviving there is no AI credit.
